json-formatter.name: JSON Formatter & Validator
json-formatter.description: Format, validate, beautify or minify JSON instantly — right in your browser.
json-formatter.seoTitle: JSON Formatter & Validator — free, local, no upload
json-formatter.seo: Paste any JSON and get it formatted with your choice of indentation, minified for production, or validated with precise error positions. The parsing uses your browser's own JSON engine, so even sensitive payloads stay on your device.

base64-converter.name: Base64 Encoder / Decoder
base64-converter.description: Convert text to Base64 and back, with full Unicode support — all in your browser.
base64-converter.seoTitle: Base64 Encoder & Decoder — Unicode-safe, runs locally
base64-converter.seo: Encode plain text to Base64 or decode Base64 back to readable text. Unlike naive converters, this tool handles the full Unicode range correctly — Chinese characters, emoji and accented letters all survive the round trip. Conversion happens entirely in your browser.

ui.invalid: That doesn't look like valid Base64.

password-generator.name: Password Generator
password-generator.description: Generate strong random passwords with your browser's crypto engine — nothing is sent anywhere.
password-generator.seo: Passwords are generated with crypto.getRandomValues(), the same cryptographically secure random source browsers use for TLS keys. Choose length and character sets, watch the entropy estimate update in real time, and copy with one click. The password never leaves this page.

ui.needOne: Select at least one character set.
ui.placeholder: Click regenerate to create a password

url-converter.name: URL Encoder / Decoder
url-converter.description: Encode and decode URLs and URI components safely — instantly, in your browser.
url-converter.seoTitle: URL Encoder & Decoder — free, runs locally
url-converter.seo: Encode special characters so they survive inside URLs and query parameters, or decode percent-encoded strings back to readable text. Choose component mode for parameter values or full-URL mode for whole links. Everything runs locally in your browser.

ui.inputPlaceholder: Type or paste text, or a percent-encoded string…
ui.invalid: That doesn't look like a percent-encoded string.

uuid-generator.name: UUID Generator
uuid-generator.description: Generate random v4 UUIDs in bulk — cryptographically random, right in your browser.
uuid-generator.seoTitle: UUID / GUID Generator — bulk v4, cryptographically random
uuid-generator.seo: Generate up to 100 RFC 4122 version-4 UUIDs with one click, using your browser's cryptographically secure random source. Toggle uppercase or remove dashes, then copy them all. Nothing is sent anywhere.

timestamp-converter.name: Unix Timestamp Converter
timestamp-converter.description: Convert Unix epoch timestamps to human-readable dates and back — with live current time.
timestamp-converter.seoTitle: Unix Timestamp Converter — epoch to date, local & UTC
timestamp-converter.seo: Paste a Unix timestamp (seconds or milliseconds — auto-detected) to see the corresponding date in your local timezone and UTC, or pick a date to get its timestamp. A live clock shows the current epoch time. All conversion happens in your browser.

html-entity-converter.name: HTML Entity Encoder / Decoder
html-entity-converter.description: Encode special characters to HTML entities and decode them back — safe for pasting code into pages.
html-entity-converter.seoTitle: HTML Entity Encoder & Decoder — runs locally
html-entity-converter.seo: Convert characters like <, >, & and quotes into their HTML entity equivalents so code snippets render safely in web pages, or decode entities back to plain text. Named entities are used where they exist. Runs entirely in your browser.

color-converter.name: Color Converter
color-converter.description: Convert colors between HEX, RGB and HSL — with a visual picker and one-click copy.
color-converter.seoTitle: Color Converter — HEX, RGB, HSL with visual picker
color-converter.seo: Pick a color visually or paste a HEX, RGB or HSL value and see every format update in sync. Copy any representation with one click for your CSS. Everything runs locally.

number-base-converter.name: Number Base Converter
number-base-converter.description: Convert numbers between binary, octal, decimal, hexadecimal and any base from 2 to 36.
number-base-converter.seoTitle: Number Base Converter — binary, octal, hex, base 2-36
number-base-converter.seo: Enter a number in any base from 2 to 36 and instantly see it in binary, octal, decimal and hexadecimal. Big values are supported exactly thanks to arbitrary-precision integers. Runs entirely in your browser.

ui.invalid: Invalid digits for the selected base

word-counter.name: Word & Character Counter
word-counter.description: Count characters, words, sentences and paragraphs in real time — with reading time estimate.
word-counter.seoTitle: Word & Character Counter — real-time text statistics
word-counter.seo: Paste or type text and watch the counts update instantly: characters with and without spaces, words, sentences, paragraphs and lines, plus an estimated reading time. Counting rules work for both English and Chinese text. Everything stays in your browser.

ui.placeholder: Start typing or paste your text…

case-converter.name: Case Converter
case-converter.description: Convert text between lowercase, UPPERCASE, Title Case, camelCase, snake_case and more.
case-converter.seoTitle: Case Converter — camelCase, snake_case, Title Case & more
case-converter.seo: One click converts your text to lowercase, UPPERCASE, Title Case, Sentence case, camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case or kebab-case. Handy when moving between code conventions and prose. Runs locally in your browser.

text-reverser.name: Text Reverser
text-reverser.description: Reverse text character by character, word by word, or line by line — instantly.
text-reverser.seoTitle: Text Reverser — flip characters, words or lines
text-reverser.seo: Flip your text three ways: reverse every character, reverse the order of words, or reverse the order of lines. Unicode-aware, so emoji and accented characters stay intact. Everything runs locally.

remove-duplicate-lines.name: Remove Duplicate Lines
remove-duplicate-lines.description: Deduplicate lines, strip blank lines and sort — with a live count of what was removed.
remove-duplicate-lines.seoTitle: Remove Duplicate Lines — dedupe, sort & strip blanks
remove-duplicate-lines.seo: Paste line-separated text and remove duplicate lines while keeping the original order, or sort the result alphabetically. Blank lines can be stripped too, and a live summary shows how many lines were removed. Runs entirely in your browser.

percentage-calculator.name: Percentage Calculator
percentage-calculator.description: Three everyday percentage questions, answered instantly: X% of Y, X is what % of Y, and % change.
percentage-calculator.seoTitle: Percentage Calculator — percent of, is what %, % change
percentage-calculator.seo: Answer the three percentage questions that come up all the time: What is X% of Y? X is what percent of Y? What is the percentage change from X to Y? Results update as you type. Runs locally in your browser.

bmi-calculator.name: BMI Calculator
bmi-calculator.description: Calculate your Body Mass Index in metric or imperial units, with WHO category feedback.
bmi-calculator.seoTitle: BMI Calculator — metric & imperial, WHO categories
bmi-calculator.seo: Enter your height and weight in metric or imperial units and get your BMI instantly, along with the WHO weight category it falls into and the healthy weight range for your height. Nothing is stored or sent anywhere.

date-difference.name: Date Difference Calculator
date-difference.description: Calculate the exact difference between two dates in days, weeks, months and years — plus business days.
date-difference.seoTitle: Date Difference Calculator — days, weeks, business days
date-difference.seo: Pick two dates and see the exact gap expressed in days, weeks, months and years, including a business-day count that skips weekends. The end date can be included or excluded. Everything runs in your browser.

random-number-generator.name: Random Number Generator
random-number-generator.description: Generate random numbers in any range — unique or repeatable, one or in bulk.
random-number-generator.seoTitle: Random Number Generator — any range, unique picks
random-number-generator.seo: Pick a minimum and maximum, choose how many numbers you want, and optionally require them to be unique or sorted. Generation uses your browser's cryptographically secure random source. Runs entirely offline.

ui.invalid: Can't pick that many unique values from this range

qr-code-generator.name: QR Code Generator
qr-code-generator.description: Create QR codes for URLs, text, Wi-Fi and more — customizable size and error correction.
qr-code-generator.seoTitle: QR Code Generator — free, customizable, runs locally
qr-code-generator.seo: Type any text or URL and get a crisp QR code instantly. Adjust the size and error-correction level, then download it as a PNG. The code is rendered entirely in your browser — your content never leaves your device.

ui.placeholder: Enter a URL or any text…

qr-code-scanner.name: QR Code Scanner
qr-code-scanner.description: Decode QR codes from images right in your browser — upload, paste or drop a picture.
qr-code-scanner.seoTitle: QR Code Scanner / Reader Online — decode from image, locally
qr-code-scanner.seo: Upload an image containing a QR code — or simply paste a screenshot — and read its contents instantly. Decoding happens entirely in your browser; the image is never uploaded to any server.

ui.dropzone: Drop an image here, click to browse, or paste from clipboard

regex-tester.name: Regex Tester
regex-tester.description: Test regular expressions with live highlighting, match groups, replacement and a pattern cheat sheet.
regex-tester.seoTitle: Regex Tester — live match highlighting & groups, runs locally
regex-tester.seo: Write a regular expression, pick your flags, and watch matches highlight in real time. Inspect every capture group with its index, try replacements, and grab common patterns from the built-in cheat sheet. Everything runs locally in your browser.

ui.testPlaceholder: Paste the text to test against…

image-compressor.name: Image Compressor
image-compressor.description: Compress JPEG, PNG and WebP images with an adjustable quality slider — instant size savings preview.
image-compressor.seoTitle: Image Compressor — shrink JPEG/PNG/WebP locally, free
image-compressor.seo: Drop in a photo and drag the quality slider to find the sweet spot between size and fidelity. The before/after file sizes update instantly and you can download the compressed result. Your images are processed entirely in your browser — nothing is uploaded.

ui.dropzone: Drop an image here, click to browse, or paste from clipboard
ui.tooBig: Compressed file is larger than the original — try a lower quality.
ui.losslessNote: PNG is a lossless format — the quality slider has no effect on it. Pick WebP or JPEG to actually shrink the file.
ui.autoWebpNote: PNG sources are lossless, so the result is exported as WebP to make compression work.

image-converter.name: Image Format Converter
image-converter.description: Convert images between PNG, JPEG and WebP formats — instant, private, in your browser.
image-converter.seoTitle: Image Converter — PNG ↔ JPG ↔ WebP, runs locally
image-converter.seo: Convert any image to PNG, JPEG or WebP with one click. Transparency is flattened onto white when converting to JPEG. Compare file sizes before downloading. Everything happens locally — your images never leave your device.

image-to-base64.description: Encode images as Base64 data URIs or decode a Base64 string back into an image — locally.
image-to-base64.seoTitle: Image to Base64 Encoder & Decoder — data URI, runs locally
image-to-base64.seo: Turn any image into a Base64 data URI ready for CSS or HTML embedding, or paste a data URI to preview and download the decoded image. Conversion happens entirely in your browser.

image-resizer.name: Image Resizer
image-resizer.description: Resize images to exact pixel dimensions with aspect-ratio lock — JPEG, PNG and WebP output.
image-resizer.seoTitle: Image Resizer — exact pixels, ratio lock, runs locally
image-resizer.seo: Shrink or enlarge an image to the exact width and height you need, with an optional aspect-ratio lock. Choose the output format and quality, preview the result size, and download. All processing is local.

exif-viewer.name: EXIF Metadata Viewer
exif-viewer.description: Inspect camera, lens, exposure and GPS metadata hidden inside JPEG photos — fully local.
exif-viewer.seoTitle: EXIF Viewer — read photo metadata & GPS locally
exif-viewer.seo: See what your photos reveal: camera make and model, lens, shutter speed, aperture, ISO, focal length, timestamps and even GPS coordinates with a map link. The file is parsed in your browser and never uploaded.

image-watermark.name: Image Watermark Tool
image-watermark.description: Add custom text watermarks to photos — position, size, opacity and tiling — all in your browser.
image-watermark.seoTitle: Image Watermark Tool — text watermark, free & local
image-watermark.seo: Protect your images with a custom text watermark. Choose the wording, size, color, opacity and one of nine positions — or tile it across the whole image. Preview updates live and the result downloads as PNG. Nothing is uploaded.

image-color-picker.name: Image Color Picker
image-color-picker.description: Pick exact colors from any image — click to grab HEX, RGB and HSL values with a zoom loupe.
image-color-picker.seoTitle: Image Color Picker — grab HEX/RGB from photos, local
image-color-picker.seo: Upload any image and click to sample the exact pixel color. A magnifying loupe helps you aim precisely. Picked colors are kept in a history strip with one-click copy in HEX, RGB and HSL. Everything runs locally.

ui.dropzone: Drop an image here, click to browse, or paste from clipboard

favicon-generator.name: Favicon Generator
favicon-generator.description: Turn any image into a complete favicon set — ICO with 16/32/48px plus PNG and Apple touch icons.
favicon-generator.seoTitle: Favicon Generator — ICO + PNG set from any image
favicon-generator.seo: Upload a logo or picture and get a ready-to-use favicon package: a multi-size .ico file (16, 32 and 48 px) plus PNG icons at 180, 192 and 512 px for Apple touch and PWA use. Everything is generated locally in your browser.

ui.dropzone: Drop a square-ish image here, click to browse, or paste from clipboard

image-cropper.name: Image Cropper
image-cropper.description: Crop images with a draggable selection and aspect-ratio presets — free, private, in-browser.
image-cropper.seoTitle: Image Cropper — drag to crop, ratio presets, local
image-cropper.seo: Drag a selection over your image to crop exactly what you need, with presets for 1:1, 4:3, 3:2 and 16:9. The cropped region keeps its original resolution. Everything runs in your browser — no uploads.

image-filters.name: Image Filters & Photo Editor
image-filters.description: Adjust brightness, contrast, saturation and more with live preview — plus one-click presets.
image-filters.seoTitle: Image Filters & Photo Editor — brightness, contrast, local
image-filters.seo: Tune brightness, contrast, saturation, grayscale, sepia, blur, hue and inversion with live sliders, or start from a preset like B&W or Vintage. The full-resolution result downloads instantly. Your photo never leaves your device.

ui.dropzone: Drop an image here, click to browse, or paste from clipboard

image-to-ascii.name: Image to ASCII Art
image-to-ascii.description: Turn images into ASCII art with adjustable width and character sets — copy or download as image.
image-to-ascii.seoTitle: Image to ASCII Art Converter — runs locally, free
image-to-ascii.seo: Convert any image into text art made of ASCII characters. Adjust the output width and pick from simple, detailed or block character sets, then copy the text or download it as a PNG. Rendering happens entirely in your browser.

ui.dropzone: Drop an image here, click to browse, or paste from clipboard

image-rotator.name: Image Rotator
image-rotator.description: Rotate images by 90° steps or any custom angle, and flip horizontally or vertically — locally.
image-rotator.seoTitle: Image Rotator & Flipper — any angle, runs locally
image-rotator.seo: Rotate photos in 90-degree steps or dial in any angle, and flip them horizontally or vertically. The rotated result keeps full quality with transparent corners. Processing is entirely local.

metadata-remover.name: EXIF & Metadata Remover
metadata-remover.description: Strip location, camera and timestamp metadata from photos before sharing them — fully local.
metadata-remover.seoTitle: EXIF Remover — strip photo metadata for privacy
metadata-remover.seo: Photos can leak where and when they were taken and what device captured them. This tool shows what metadata your image carries and produces a clean copy with all of it stripped. Processing happens in your browser — the photo is never uploaded.

color-extractor.name: Color Palette Extractor
color-extractor.description: Extract dominant colors from any image and get a ready-to-use palette with HEX and RGB codes.
color-extractor.seoTitle: Color Extractor — dominant palette from any image
color-extractor.seo: Pull the dominant colors out of a photo or artwork and get a clean palette with HEX and RGB values, ready for your design work. Choose how many colors you want and copy any swatch with one click. Everything runs locally.

unit-converter.name: Unit Converter
unit-converter.description: Convert length, weight, temperature, area, volume, speed and data-storage units instantly — all locally.
unit-converter.seoTitle: Unit Converter — length, weight, temperature, volume & more
unit-converter.seo: Free online unit converter covering length, weight, temperature, area, volume, speed and digital storage. Pick a category, type a value and read the result instantly — metric, imperial and US customary units included. Everything runs locally in your browser: no sign-up, no uploads.

scientific-calculator.name: Scientific Calculator
scientific-calculator.description: Free online scientific calculator with trigonometry, logarithms, powers, factorials, memory keys and history.
scientific-calculator.seoTitle: Scientific Calculator — trig, logs, powers, memory
scientific-calculator.seo: A full scientific calculator that runs entirely in your browser: trigonometric functions in degrees or radians, natural and common logarithms, powers, roots, factorials, the constants π and e, parentheses, memory keys and a tappable history. Keyboard input supported. No sign-up — nothing is sent anywhere.

hash-generator.name: Hash Generator — MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256
hash-generator.description: Compute MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512 hashes of any text instantly — 100% in your browser.
hash-generator.seoTitle: MD5 & SHA Hash Generator — SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512
hash-generator.seo: Type or paste text and instantly get its MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512 digests in hex. Hashes are computed locally with the Web Crypto API plus a pure-JavaScript MD5, so your input never leaves the device. One-click copy for every digest.

ui.note: MD5 and SHA-1 are considered broken for security purposes — prefer SHA-256 or stronger.

jwt-decoder.name: JWT Decoder
jwt-decoder.description: Decode JSON Web Tokens locally: inspect the header, payload claims and expiry — the token never leaves your browser.
jwt-decoder.seoTitle: JWT Decoder — inspect header, payload & expiry locally
jwt-decoder.seo: Paste a JSON Web Token to instantly decode its header and payload. Registered claims (iss, sub, aud, exp, nbf, iat, jti) are explained, and timestamps are converted to readable dates with live expiry status. Decoding happens entirely in your browser — the token is never transmitted. Note: this tool decodes but does not verify signatures.

ui.sigNote: Signature is displayed but not verified — verification requires the secret or a public key.
ui.invalid: Invalid JWT — expected three Base64url segments separated by dots.
ui.decodeErr: Segment could not be decoded as JSON.

text-diff.name: Text Diff — Compare Texts
text-diff.description: Compare two texts line by line with additions and deletions highlighted — a free, private, in-browser diff checker.
text-diff.seoTitle: Text Diff Checker — compare two texts online
text-diff.seo: Paste two versions of a text and see the differences highlighted line by line: additions in green, deletions in red, with optional case-insensitive and whitespace-trimming comparison. The diff runs locally using the Myers algorithm — nothing is uploaded.
